NASCAR is an American company based in Florida. The company specializes in competitive racing. The average NASCAR car reaches over 321 km/h (200 mph) holding a V8 engine.

Jaguar is a British car manufacturer based in Coventry. The company manufactures luxury cars. The fastest Jaguar is the XE SV Project 8 reaching over 322 km/h (200 mph), also powered by a V8 engine.

A jaguar is also an animal, the largest of the feline species. They originate in northern Mexico southward to northern Argentina and are regarded as the second fastest feline species coming close under the Cheetah. Jaguars reach a top speed of 80 km/h (50 mph).
